q1.sampleAnswer: To work in an art museum.

examples: to work in an art museum

q1.rubricZh: 要点：在艺术博物馆工作。
q1.explanationZh: 第一段说他小时候的梦想就是在艺术博物馆工作，而且一直没忘。

evidence.quote: As a young child, my dream was to work in an art museum.

q2.explanationZh: 第二段说他是通过博物馆的网站联系上博物馆的。

evidence.quote: I got in touch with the museum through its website.

q3.explanationZh: 第二段说他在 7 月 10 日开始做每次两小时的志愿轮班。

evidence.quote: On July 10, I started doing some two-hour

q4.sampleAnswer: To look after the selected items on the “Talking Tables”.

keyPoints.descZh: 照看“Talking Tables”上精选的展品

q4.rubricZh: 要点：照看“Talking Tables”上的展品。
q4.explanationZh: 第二段说“Talking Tables”上有一些精选展品，他的工作就是照看这些展品。

evidence.quote: My job is to look after these items.

q5.sampleAnswer: He feels respected and valued, and finds it enjoyable to be useful in a completely different role and working environment from those of his regular job.

keyPoints.descZh: 觉得自己受到尊重和重视
觉得在和本职工作完全不同的角色和环境里发挥作用很愉快
examples: It is enjoyable to be useful in a completely different role and working environment.

q5.rubricZh: 要点：①受到尊重和重视；②在与本职不同的角色和环境中有用，感到愉快。
q5.explanationZh: 最后一段说他觉得被尊重、被重视，而且在和护士工作完全不同的岗位上帮上忙，很愉快。

evidence.quote: I have felt respected and valued.

q6.sampleAnswer: Yes, I do. Since I’m interested in art and history, volunteering at a local museum can be an excellent opportunity to gain valuable experience and personal growth. What’s more, I can also help others through volunteering.(Answers may vary.)

examples: Volunteering at a local museum can be an excellent opportunity to gain valuable experience.

q6.rubricZh: 开放题：明确表态，并给出合理理由即可。
q6.explanationZh: 这是开放题。先说想不想，再给理由，比如你对艺术历史感兴趣，或者想帮助别人、学到新东西。

evidence.quote: I have always been interested in art and history.

q7.explanationZh: “表达”快乐用 express，Words can’t express how happy I am. 是常见说法，意思是“言语无法表达我有多高兴”。

q8.explanationZh: before I forget it 是“趁我还没忘记”，前面写下日期就是怕忘，所以选 forget。

q9.explanationZh: a very 后面要形容词修饰 meal，“愉快的一餐”用 enjoyable。

q10.explanationZh: which one we have 是“我们选哪个”，you decide 是“你来决定”，这里 decide 用原形。

q11.explanationZh: do our best to 后面接动词原形，“支持学生取得成功”用 support。

q12.explanationZh: deliver the table 指“送桌子过来”，deliver 有“递送”的意思。

q13.explanationZh: “从出生起”用 since 引导的时间状语：since I was born，前面 have lived 是现在完成时。
q13.tipsZh: since + 过去时间/从句 自……以来

accept: have never forgotten my dream to work

q14.explanationZh: “从未忘记”用现在完成时 have never forgotten，“……的梦想”用 my dream to work。

accept: I got in touch with the museum

q15.explanationZh: “取得联系”是 get in touch with，这里讲过去的事，用 got。
q15.tipsZh: get in touch with 与……取得联系

accept: visiting art museums and appreciating new artworks

q16.explanationZh: enjoy 后面接动名词，所以用 visiting ... and appreciating ...，“欣赏”可用 appreciating。
q16.tipsZh: enjoy doing sth. 喜欢做某事

q17.explanationZh: “决定试一试”是 decide to go for it，go for it 的意思是“放手一试”，因为说的是上个月的事，用过去式 decided。
q17.tipsZh: go for it 放手一试

accept: My job is to help the professor

q18.explanationZh: “我的工作是……”用 My job is to，后面接动词原形 help；“教授”是 the professor。
q18.tipsZh: My job is to do sth. 我的工作是做某事
